summary:
**EARTHSONA — Hear the Earth, Understand the Planet**

EARTHSONA is an interactive 3D Earth information and sonification platform developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge's "The Earth Information Jukebox." It allows users to explore our planet through an interactive globe, select geographical regions and investigate environmental information through four layers: Natural, Ocean, Forest and Lightning.

The platform transforms available numerical Earth science data into sound, allowing users to experience environmental information through both visual and auditory representations. Region-specific sound generation and animated audio visualizations make scientific information more engaging and accessible, particularly for people who are blind or have low vision. Users can also explore geographical details, including country, region and coordinates, alongside available scientific information and its sources.

EARTHSONA aims to make complex Earth science easier to explore, understand and experience. By combining interactive visualization with sonification, it creates a more inclusive way to connect people with our planet and its changing environmental systems.
details:
How EARTHSONA Works

EARTHSONA is an interactive 3D Earth exploration platform that combines geographical visualization, environmental information and sound to make Earth science more engaging and accessible.

Users can interact with a realistic 3D globe, select geographical locations and explore four information layers: Natural, Ocean, Forest and Lightning. When a location is selected, the application displays relevant geographical details, including its country, region, latitude, longitude and available environmental information.

One of EARTHSONA's main features is data sonification. It transforms available numerical environmental information into sound, allowing users to experience selected Earth data through audio as well as visual representations. Animated audio visualizations help users follow the sound as it plays.

Benefits and Intended Impact

EARTHSONA provides an alternative way to explore and understand Earth science. By combining visual and auditory experiences, it aims to make environmental information more accessible, particularly for people who are blind or have low vision. It also encourages students and the general public to explore geographical locations and develop a greater interest in our planet.

Technology and Tools

The project was developed using Google AI Studio Build mode with AI-assisted application development. It uses interactive 3D globe visualization, web-based application technologies and browser audio capabilities to provide geographical exploration and sound generation. NASA Earth science resources and datasets are used where integrated and available.

Creativity and Design Considerations

The creative aspect of EARTHSONA is its combination of an interactive Earth globe and data sonification in one experience. Instead of only displaying environmental information through maps and visualizations, it allows users to hear representations of available scientific data.

During development, we considered accessibility, ease of navigation, geographical accuracy, scientific data reliability, audio clarity and the importance of distinguishing actual scientific measurements from illustrative representations. The goal is to make exploring our planet an experience that can be seen, heard and understood.
